_object: Pre-committed outcome map for the G-OMEGA resolution probe (does the V_quad Borel operator L_V have coefficients algebraic over Q(sqrt3)?). Written in Stage 0 BEFORE any computation per Strengthening Condition 2; the Stage-5 selection is mechanical against this map; NO post-hoc reframing.

outcome_GO_clean.condition: L_V is algebraic over Q(sqrt3) with coefficients in Q(sqrt3)
outcome_GO_clean.next_step: Open PERIOD-REP-VQUAD-003 for sub-problem B (rapid-decay cycle formalization) and sub-problem C (symbolic verification via L_V)
outcome_GO_clean.paper_framing: An Explicit Fresan-Jossen Exponential-Period Representation of the V_quad Connection Coefficient

outcome_GO_small_extension.condition: L_V is algebraic over a small explicit extension of Q(sqrt3), e.g. Q(sqrt3, sqrt-1) or Q(sqrt3, zeta_n) for small n
outcome_GO_small_extension.next_step: Same as outcome_GO_clean, but track the base field explicitly through sub-problems B and C
outcome_GO_small_extension.tentative_venue: JSC, Math Annalen, or Constructive Approximation
outcome_GO_small_extension.paper_framing: Same as GO-clean, with base field stated in the title or abstract

outcome_GO_larger_field.condition: L_V is algebraic over a non-CM extension or a genuinely larger field (rank >= 4 over Q)
outcome_GO_larger_field.next_step: Reconsider framing. The paper still goes through, but the Fresan-Jossen application becomes less clean. Consider broader framework (Brown-Dupont, generalized period ring). Pause for operator review before proceeding to sub-problem B.
outcome_GO_larger_field.tentative_venue: JSC or Letters in Mathematical Physics; Compositio off-table
outcome_GO_larger_field.paper_framing: An Exponential-Period Integral Representation of the V_quad Connection Coefficient over <field>

outcome_NO_GO_clean.condition: L_V is provably D-transcendental — the Borel transform B-hat(xi) does not satisfy any algebraic differential equation
outcome_NO_GO_clean.next_step: Two options to present to operator: (a) pivot to the relative/family period framing (the Borel transform may be algebraic in a parameter family even if not at the specific V_quad point), or (b) table Direction 2 and select an alternative direction from the original five (1, 3, 4, or 5)
outcome_NO_GO_clean.tentative_venue: If shorter Borel-structure paper is extracted: JSC or Constructive Approximation
outcome_NO_GO_clean.paper_framing: If shorter paper is written: 'The Borel Structure of the V_quad Asymptotic Expansion' (without transcendence claim)

outcome_INCONCLUSIVE.condition: Neither algebraicity nor D-transcendence can be established within the 2-week budget
outcome_INCONCLUSIVE.next_step: Operator review: decide whether to extend the probe budget, or to accept the inconclusive result and either table Direction 2 or write the conditional-on-algebraicity paper

_selection_rule.GO_small_extension: L_V coefficients in Q(sqrt3, sqrt-1), Q(sqrt3, zeta_n) small, or similar CM/cyclotomic extension
_selection_rule.GO_larger_field: L_V coefficients in non-CM or rank>=4 field
_selection_rule.NO_GO_clean: no holonomic ODE found AND D-transcendence more strongly evidenced
_selection_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no holonomic ODE found within budget, Stage 3.6 inconclusive
_selection_rule.operator_review_flag: holonomic ODE found but operator structure unusable for the Fresan-Jossen application

_do_not: DO NOT declare GO_clean if the coefficient field is anything other than Q(sqrt3) — even Q(sqrt3, sqrt-1) is GO_small_extension.
